title: Tweakable Sulfur Cubes
description: Enlarge, Shrink and Give Permanent Effects to your Sulfur Cube
body:
### You can use various items to customize your Sulfur Cubes:

- Redstone Dust makes the current effects a Sulfur Cube has permanent

- Milk Buckets cleanse the effects of Sulfur Cubes

- Slime Balls enlarge Sulfur Cubes

- Water Buckets shrink Sulfur Cubes

**Known Bugs:**
- Picking up Sulfur Cubes with buckets reset their size ([MC-308422](https://report.bugs.mojang.com/servicedesk/customer/portal/2/MC-308427))

Contact me on Discord for any issues! @hexasan

![A sulfur cube getting enlarged with a slime ball](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hexasan/Hexasan/refs/heads/main/enlarge_sulfur.GIF)
